target.purpose: Produce deterministic, policy-bound tool-decision transcripts whose schema identity, call identity, arguments, decision chain, and replay proof cannot drift independently.
target.central_bottleneck: A transcript is not reproducible proof if tool arguments are omitted from identity, call IDs can be rebound, schema versions are implicit, or replay has no independently recomputable receipt.

invariants: red-line refusal dominates schema state and never becomes ALLOW
allowed tool decisions require the policy-bound schema version and schema digest
a call ID is one-shot: exact replay is idempotent and changed input is rejected
tool arguments are strict canonical JSON and are bound into input and decision identity
transcript entries bind sequence and previous fingerprint
replay receipts bind policy, ordered calls, requested count, unique entry count, and transcript root
Python and Node preserve fixed cross-runtime hash vectors
non-finite and unsupported evidence fails closed
nonclaims: replay receipts are deterministic hashes rather than cryptographic signatures
tool schema digests are policy-supplied rather than registry-authenticated
the transcript does not execute tools or verify their results
